verses.text: This message came to Jeremiah about all the Jews living in Egypt, in Migdol, Tahpanhes, Memphis, and the region of Pathros:
"This is what the LORD of Armies, the God of Israel, says: You have seen all the disaster I brought on Jerusalem and on all the towns of Judah. Today they are in ruins, and no one lives in them.
This happened because of the evil they did. They made me angry by burning incense and worshiping other gods that neither they nor you nor your ancestors had ever known.
Again and again I sent you my servants the prophets to say, 'Please do not do this disgusting thing that I hate!'
But they did not listen or pay attention. They did not turn from their wickedness or stop burning incense to other gods.
So my fury and anger were poured out. They burned like fire through the towns of Judah and the streets of Jerusalem, and made them the ruined wasteland they are today."

"So now this is what the LORD God of Armies, the God of Israel, says: Why are you bringing such great disaster on yourselves? You are cutting off from Judah men and women, children and babies, so that no one will be left.

Why do you make me angry with the idols you make with your hands, burning incense to other gods here in Egypt where you have come to live? You will destroy yourselves and become a curse and a disgrace among all the nations of the earth.
Have you forgotten the wickedness done by your ancestors, by the kings of Judah and their wives, and by you and your wives, in the land of Judah and the streets of Jerusalem?
To this day they have not humbled themselves or shown respect. They have not followed my law or the rules I set before you and your ancestors."
"So this is what the LORD of Armies, the God of Israel, says: Look, I have decided to bring disaster on you and to destroy all Judah.

I will take the survivors of Judah who were determined to go to Egypt and live there, and they will all die. They will fall in Egypt, killed by war and famine. From the least to the greatest, they will die by war and famine. They will become an object of cursing and horror, of mockery and disgrace.
I will punish those who live in Egypt just as I punished Jerusalem, with war, famine, and disease.

None of the survivors of Judah who have gone to live in Egypt will escape or survive to go back to the land of Judah. They long to go back and live there, but no one will go back except a few who escape."
Then all the men who knew their wives were burning incense to other gods, and all the women standing there, a large crowd, and all the people living in Pathros in Egypt, answered Jeremiah,
"We will not listen to the message you have spoken to us in the LORD's name!

We will certainly do everything we have said we would. We will burn incense to the Queen of Heaven and pour out drink offerings to her, just as we, our ancestors, our kings, and our officials did in the towns of Judah and the streets of Jerusalem. At that time we had plenty of food. We were well off and had no trouble.
But ever since we stopped burning incense to the Queen of Heaven and pouring out drink offerings to her, we have had nothing, and we have been dying by war and famine."

And the women said, "When we burned incense to the Queen of Heaven and poured out drink offerings to her, did we make cakes in her image and pour out drink offerings to her without our husbands knowing and agreeing?"
Then Jeremiah said to all the people, both men and women, who had answered him,

"Do you think the LORD did not remember the incense you burned in the towns of Judah and the streets of Jerusalem, you and your ancestors, your kings, your officials, and the people of the land? Do you think it did not come to his mind?

The LORD could not put up with it any longer, because of your evil actions and the disgusting things you did. That is why your land became a ruin, an object of horror and cursing, with no one living in it, as it is today.
This disaster has come on you, as you see today, because you burned incense and sinned against the LORD. You did not obey him or follow his law, his rules, and his instructions."
Then Jeremiah said to all the people, including all the women, "Listen to the LORD's message, all you people of Judah who are in Egypt.

This is what the LORD of Armies, the God of Israel, says: You and your wives have said with your mouths and shown with your actions, 'We will certainly keep the vows we made to burn incense to the Queen of Heaven and to pour out drink offerings to her.' Go ahead, then. Keep your promises and carry out your vows!

But listen to the LORD's message, all you people of Judah living in Egypt: 'I have sworn by my great name,' says the LORD, 'that no one from Judah living anywhere in Egypt will ever again use my name in an oath, saying, "As surely as the Lord GOD lives."
For I am watching over them to bring disaster, not good. All the people of Judah in Egypt will die by war and famine until they are all gone.
Only a few will escape the sword and come back from Egypt to the land of Judah. Then all the survivors of Judah who came to live in Egypt will know whose word comes true, mine or theirs.
This will be the sign to you,' says the LORD, 'that I will punish you in this place, so that you will know my threats of disaster against you will certainly come true.'

This is what the LORD says: 'Look, I will hand Pharaoh Hophra king of Egypt over to his enemies who want to kill him, just as I handed Zedekiah king of Judah over to his enemy Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, who wanted to kill him.'"
